jp: 充填する必要はないみたい
jp_grezzo: "充填する必要はないみたい" + _da()
en: Reload what? You don't have any ammo in your inventory.
en_grezzo: "Reload what? You don't have any ammo in your inventory."
it: Ricaricare cosa? Non hai munizioni nello zaino.
Al momento è ancora in preparazione.

jp: そう、全員の特殊矢弾を補充すると
jp_grezzo: "そう" + _dana(3) + "、全員の特殊矢弾を補充すると" + calccostreload(CHARA_PLAYER) + strgold + _da()
en: Sure, let me check what type of ammo you need... Okay, reloading all of your ammo will cost  gold pieces.
en_grezzo: "Sure, let me check what type of ammo you need... Okay, reloading all of your ammo will cost " + calccostreload(CHARA_PLAYER) + " gold pieces."
contesto: buff = lang("そう" + _dana(3) + "、全員の特殊矢弾を補充すると" + calccostreload(CHARA_PLAYER) + strgold + _da(), "Sure, let me check what type of ammo you need... Okay, reloading all of your ammo will cost " + calccostreload(CHARA_PLAYER) + " gold pieces.")
it: "Vediamo di che munizioni hai bisogno... Ecco: ricaricarle tutte ti costa " + calccostreload(CHARA_PLAYER) + " monete d'oro."
